If you can provide a higher-resolution PDF or the text extract of the Balance Sheet (liabilities: 'Claims outstanding' gross for 2013) and the specific 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (insurance liabilities/gross column), I can fill all fields precisely and compute percentages and mappings.
